postTitle: Windfalls: Bonuses, Inheritances, and Sale Proceeds
topic: A one off windfall can turn into a permanent monthly cost

assumptions.notes: €400 a month = €4,800 a year. €50,000 / 4,800 = 10.4 years (about 10 years 5 months). Windfall line held flat at €50,000; upgrade line = total paid so far. Before growth, tax or inflation. Illustrative.

lineRace.disclosure: Illustrative. €400 a month, before growth, tax or inflation.

hookVariants.narration: Fifty thousand euros from a bonus or an inheritance. How long can it pay for a four hundred euro a month upgrade?

beats.narration: Four hundred a month is four thousand eight hundred a year.
After about ten years and five months, the upgrade has used up the whole fifty thousand. And the monthly cost keeps going.
